_comment: The lift the car in the bay goes up on (the parts view's lift button): a two-post lift, made by tools/GarageScene/build_props.py from the Sketchfab model in its credit (CC BY 4.0), its posts either side of the car and its carriages and arms the rising part, lift_post, the top of the arms (where the car rests) at that node's origin. A mod's model names its rising part the same; with no model named, the game draws its own from boxes, an in-ground post with a saddle. Its place says the garage has one and the floor's height there: the lift stands under the middle of the car in the bay, whatever its position's x and z. A garage it has no place in still lifts the car, with no lift drawn.
name: Lift
